Duplicate-scope and partial-synonym screen recorded 2026-09-23: (i) the catalog carries nontoxic-thyroid-enlargement as a separate identity that already owns thyroid-enlargement territory (carrying the ME-14 hypoparathyroidism association edge derived from multinodular goiter surgery literature) - goiter and nontoxic thyroid enlargement name overlapping conditions (nontoxic goiter versus any thyroid enlargement), so goiter is either a synonym superset or an umbrella spanning the nontoxic entity plus toxic-function forms; either construction forbids parallel paths: authoring goiter edges would duplicate the nontoxic identity's pathway for the shared subset while the toxic subset belongs to hyperthyroidism, hyperthyroidism-to-hypothyroidism treatment transitions, thyroiditis, thyroid-storm, and toxic-function identities (the batch-37 geographic-tongue synonym ban and the batch-37 gastrointestinal-cancers class ban both apply); the hypothyroidism direction (endemic and invasive goiters progressing to underfunction) is owned by thyroiditis and hypothyroidism's own literature with iodine-status and autoimmune-thyroiditis drivers that have their own identities, and the hyperthyroidism direction belongs to toxic adenoma and Graves-type pathways; (iii) wrong-target guard for tracheal compression - no stridor or airway-obstruction identity exists (tracheal-stenosis is a distinct scar-stenosis entity), so the compressive-airway arm has no correct target; (iv) Riedel's thyroiditis and thyroid-nodules identities carry the fibrotic and nodular scopes separately. Reopening condition: a governance decision resolving goiter versus nontoxic-thyroid-enlargement scope, after which the surviving identity can absorb the compressive or functional pathway once.
